# persistent-draft

`useDraft` is the reactive `useState` drop-in; `readDraft`/`writeDraft` are the
render-free twin over the same key grammar, envelope and TTL, for callers writing
at input frequency (a scroll offset, a caret position) where a render per write
would be absurd. Reach for those rather than hand-rolling a second envelope.

`storage: "session"` keeps a value in this browser tab only (it survives a
reload and dies with the tab) instead of `localStorage`, for state that is one
tab's own — the prototype canvas, keyed by its pane instance.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Generic localStorage-backed persistence with optional entity scope and TTL auto-expiry: useDraft is the reactive useState drop-in (all calls on one key stay in sync within and across tabs); readDraft/writeDraft are the render-free imperative twin for callers writing at input frequency; onDraftWritten observes every write and clear in the tab; onDraftWriteFailed every write the browser refused.
- Web:
  - Slots: `DraftSlots.Root`
  - Slot contributors: `DraftSlots.Root` ← `primitives.persistent-draft.unsaved-warning`
  - Contributes: `Core.Root`
  - Exports (types):
    - `DraftOptions`
    - `DraftWrite`
  - Exports (values):
    - `clearDraft`
    - `DEFAULT_DRAFT_TTL`
    - `draftKey`
    - `DraftSlots`
    - `onDraftWriteFailed`
    - `onDraftWritten`
    - `readDraft`
    - `useDraft`
    - `writeDraft`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: 28 plugins — full list in [REFERENCE.md](./REFERENCE.md)
    - `apps` ×9
    - `primitives` ×9
    - `conversations` ×7
    - `map`
    - `page/editor`
    - `tasks/task-draft-form`
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`unsaved-warning`** — Warns once per page load, with an error toast, when the browser refuses to save a draft (storage full or blocked) — the text then lives only in memory and a reload loses it.
